import json
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
def rebuild(row):
    params=json.loads(row['params'])
    if row['model']=='LogReg':
        return LogisticRegression(**params)
    return RandomForestClassifier(**params,random_state=int(row['seed']))
checks=[]
for _,row in journal.iterrows():
    score=cross_val_score(make(rebuild(row)),X_train,y_train,cv=CV,scoring='roc_auc').mean()
    checks.append({'run_id':row['run_id'],'logged':round(row['cv_auc_mean'],4),'reproduced':round(score,4),'ok':bool(abs(score-row['cv_auc_mean'])<.0005)})
check_df=pd.DataFrame(checks)
broken=check_df.loc[~check_df.ok,'run_id'].iloc[0]
print(check_df,broken)

wins=int((diff>0).sum())
